item.title: Webb telescope finds signs of ancient disaster for Neptune's moons
"Clean" Code, Horrible Performance (2023)
item.description:
📝 Some of the most-often repeated programming advice, especially to beginner programmers, is that they should be writing “clean” code. That moniker is accompanied by a long list of rules that tell you what you should do in order for your code to be “clean”. This way, I am not making anything up, I’m just assessing “clean” code advocates’ rules using the example code they give to illustrate those rules.
🔗 Read more: https://www.computerenhance.com/p/clean-code-horrible-performance
